values.binNote: The wiki states the minimum damage threshold is doubled against recently-feared targets, but no bin calculation doubles FiddleSticksQ.MinimumDamage; only the percent-health damage calc (TotalPercentHealthDamageFeared) is explicitly doubled in the bin.

mechanics.claim: The crow arrives (and damage/fear applies) at the end of the cast time, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: arrives after {{tt|{{fd|0.35}} seconds|Fixed travel time from the start of the cast time}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|fear|fearing}} them for a duration

mechanics.claim: Terrify still deals its damage even if Fiddlesticks dies or loses sight of the target during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Terrify'' will still cast and affect the target even if '''Fiddlesticks''' dies or loses {{tip|sight}} of them during the cast time.

mechanics.claim: If the target was recently feared by Fiddlesticks, Terrify deals double damage and has a doubled minimum damage threshold instead of normal.
mechanics.quote: If the target has recently been feared by '''Fiddlesticks''', ''Terrify'' will instead deal {{ccs|double damage|magic}}.

mechanics.claim: Terrify's damage is capped at 400 against monsters.
mechanics.quote: ''Terrify'' has a minimum damage threshold and is capped at 400 against {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: The passive fear only applies while Fiddlesticks is out of combat and unseen, or impersonating an effigy; this does not change damage numbers but gates the doubled-damage/fear mechanic.
mechanics.quote: While '''Fiddlesticks''' has been [[combat status|out of combat]] for at least {{tt|{{fd|2.25}} seconds|Estimated}} and is not {{tip|sight|visible}} to the enemy team, or is impersonating an ''{{ai|A Harmless Scarecrow|Fiddlesticks|Effigy}}'', its damaging ability will additionally {{tip|fear}} targets hit for a duration.
